title: Savory Chinese Pork Dumplings
description: Delight in these pan-seared pork dumplings infused with a sweet and sour sauce, a perfect fusion of Eastern flavors.
instructions: Combine pork, sesame oil, chili flakes, soy sauce, and vinegar in a bowl. Mix well.
Place a wonton wrapper on a clean surface. Place a tablespoon of the pork mixture in the center of the wrapper.
Dip your finger in water and run it along the edges of the wrapper. Fold the wrapper into a triangle by bringing the two opposite corners together to form a point.
Press the edges together to seal the dumpling. Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling.
Heat a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add a small amount of sesame oil to the pan.
When the oil is hot, add the dumplings to the pan, leaving some space between each dumpling.
Cook the dumplings for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Remove the dumplings from the pan and serve with your favorite dipping sauce.
Optional: Steam the dumplings for 5-7 minutes to cook them through before pan-frying.
